programme.desc: Grass. Dee encourages a friend to say 'grass', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see green, spiky and hairy grass, and Dee finds some fairy grass!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Lair of Shares. One and friends can only escape from the Lair of Shares by learning how to share and solving the puzzles inside.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Think. Alphablock I has to clear up spilt INK. She turns it PINK, gets stuck in a SINK, slips on the ice in a RINK but manages to THINK of skates. Now, she can THANK her helpful friends.

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: First Things First. Sing along with Go and Stop as they get ready for a picnic.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Lighter and Darker. Green stages a magic shows to introduce her new friends Black and White. Learn the difference between light, bright and dark colours.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Christmas Badge. The Squirrels try to inspire Duggee's friend Clarence, who has lost his Christmas cheer.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: You Can Do It Yukee. When a radio station decides to broadcast from Yukee's garden, she finds herself with an unexpected guest spot.

programme.title: Something Special: A Magical Christmas
programme.desc: A Magical Christmas. It's Christmas Eve and the Tumble family are trying to get ready for Christmas Day. But will Father Christmas visit Mr Tumble's house?

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Treasure Trail. Preschool series. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po follow a trail of flowers that leads them to some very special treasure.

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures
programme.desc: Andy and the Flamingos. Andy heads to the Andes in South America to paint some flamingos in a mountain lake.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle's Rehearsal. The Poodles' Class rehearse for the school show, and Waffle has a special line to sing.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: The Giant Carrot. Ruby is excited to see the carrot she planted at Bob's allotment - it's going to be huge!

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Octonauts and the Bomber Worms. Preschool animation. While diving down to the Midnight Zone, the Octonauts are attacked by bomber worms and have to rescue an injured colleague.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: The Tale of the Great Potato Blunder. Peter hears about his father's greatest heist and embarks on a high-risk highway robbery.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Snowman Badge. Animated preschool series. The Squirrels play outside in the snow and decide to build a jolly-looking snowman, but the punky penguins poke fun at it.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Sweetwood's Snowy Day. When Zigzag refuses to wear mittens, it is up to Vida to convince her before she gets too cold.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: The Chilli Rocket. Chilli pretends he's a superskateboarder, but he can't really skate at all!

programme.title: New: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Mission Showtime. Spicy directs a show without Weasy, so he forces his way onto the stage.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Unicorse. Bluey's bedtime story is disturbed by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world.

programme.title: Bluey
